| description = Estrella is a druid and a pretty tough fight. Spawns at #8 on the map.  Has an obscenely large mana pool; casts dispel, superior heal, starfire and will gate at low health.  Spam stuns/mez on her once she hits 20% to prevent a gate or she will start summoning players to her spawn point.

If you're a druid and you're heading to the seahorse caves to camp the tainted/corrupted seahorse be extremely wary of her large aggro radius and hug the wall when traveling through her room, or risk becoming fish food.

Soloing her is a sort of rite of passage for charming Druids.
